facts.fact: Industry research cited by Universal Ads (eMarketer 2025, VAB 2024) suggests pause ads are 43% more memorable than standard ads.
facts.quote: industry research suggesting that pause ads are 43% more memorable than standard ads

facts.fact: Industry research cited by Universal Ads reports that over half of surveyed viewers took an action after seeing a pause ad.
facts.quote: over half of surveyed viewers reporting they took an action after seeing a pause ad

facts.fact: Universal Ads is offering pause ads as a self-serve option, in contrast to traditional one-off direct deals.
facts.quote: As well as making pause ads available as a self-serve option versus traditional one-off direct deals

facts.fact: Advertisers can create pause ad campaigns across premium TV publishers on the Universal Ads self-service platform, using the same targeting and measurement tools available for its other ads.
facts.quote: advertisers will be able to create a campaign across premium TV publishers with pause ads just as easily as they would with a standard streaming ad

facts.fact: Digital agency SearchKings says its network includes more than 6,000 advertisers (a partner's own claim, not independently verified).
facts.quote: Our network of more than 6,000 advertisers continues to invest in premium video

facts.fact: SearchKings and BUFFS are early testing partners for pause ads within the Universal Ads platform.
facts.quote: Among the early testing partners for the availability of pause ads within the Universal Ads platform are digital advertising agency SearchKings and healthy snack brand BUFFS.
